atoms.text:
The continent of Europe is located entirely in the Northern Hemisphere. It is surrounded by the Arctic Ocean, the Atlantic Ocean, and the Mediterranean Sea. In terms of land mass, it’s the second-smallest continent.

Europe’s climate is normally quite mild, but summers in the southern and central-eastern regions can be hot. Most of the countries away from the Mediterranean experience all four seasons. Europe’s climate is influenced by the Gulf Stream, which originates in the Gulf of Mexico.

Europe is also home to the European Union (EU), an international union of 27 countries. The European Union was founded in 1993 in Maastricht, in the Netherlands. Many countries in the EU also belong to the eurozone, which means they all use the euro as their official currency. Britain was a member of the EU, but exited the union in 2020.

Almost every country in Europe has its own language. Russian is the most spoken language in Europe, with the most native speakers. German and French are the next most widely-spoken native languages. English is the fourth most spoken native language, but it is also the language spoken most as a second language.

hint.text: To conserve something means to protect it.
hint.label: Conserve

atoms.text:
Tropical rainforests are ecosystems which have a warm and wet climate. They also have no real dry season. These types of rainforests can be found near the equator.

Rainforests typically have four layers: emergent, upper canopy, understory and forest floor. Trees can grow to be very tall, sometimes up to 60 metres high. Most plants are found in the top three layers, because they aren’t able to survive on the forest floor.

Rainforests are important for many reasons. The many plants which can be found there take in carbon dioxide and produce oxygen. Additionally, many natural medicines have been found in rainforests. There are also many resources to be found, but it is important to conserve rainforests and protect the different species and their habitats.

Deforestation is the removal or loss of trees from rainforests, and this is a huge problem for climate change. Deforestation can occur for many reasons, some of which include cutting down trees for wood, as well as clearing them to free up farming land.
